description.value: Causeway Bay Hotel & Conference Centre is a full-service hotel in Sparwood at the heart of the Elk Valley, steps from the famous Titan Truck landmark. The property includes an on-site restaurant and lounge alongside three conference and event spaces ranging from an 18-person boardroom to a 130-person ballroom. It sits within 30 minutes of world-class skiing and close to hiking trails, making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists touring the Kootenay region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content successfully loaded and corroborates the OSM record: address (102 Red Cedar Drive, Sparwood, BC), phone (250-425-2003), and email all match. The website confirms the hotel is operational with on-site dining (Gateway Restaurant and Rockies Lounge) but makes no mention of bike storage, laundry, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null. The OSM internet_access=wlan tag is not confirmed by the website, so Wi-Fi stays null per the rules.
concerns: Website header spells the name 'Causeway Bay Hotel & Conference Center' (with 'Center') while the main page body and OSM both use 'Centre' — minor inconsistency on the business's own site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational hotel with confirmed website, matching address and phone, active restaurant and lounge — straightforward inclusion.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Rockies Lounge open 4pm–11pm with food service until 10pm; Gateway Restaurant also on premises
